title: Generate every backend from one compiled description

The Verilog `StepLogic` and `RuleAction`, the Uppaal `ReleaseFunction` and `DeliverFunction`, and the Metal kernel each re-derive per-neuron decisions the C# step makes, and each exporter is a static class with its own signature, result type, refusal check (`SpikeTrace.Choices`, `HardwareProfile.Problems`, `RefuseUncovered`) and tool runner (`NirExporter` finds Python itself).
We want one compiled description of a network (per neuron: threshold table, delay kind, produce, open or closed, port role) that every generator reads, and an exporter interface with typed refusals and a typed co-simulation result.

Its responsibilities are:
* The compiled description, built from `CompiledNetwork` or replacing it, holding every decision a generator needs
* An `IExporter` with `Refusals(network)` returning typed reasons and `Export(network)` returning the files to write
* A `CoSimulation` result shared by Verilog, NIR and Uppaal (passed, differed at a step, tool missing), in place of a bool list and a string
* Python and norse lookup moved into `ExternalTool` beside iverilog and verifyta
* Port recording in the Uppaal model generated from `PortRecorder`'s rule, and the contract judge from `ContractTask`'s, as far as a model allows
* One identifier and file-stem cleaner, in place of `PartLibraryFiles.Stem` and `VerilogExporter.Identifier`
* Export no longer depending on `Storage` or `Evolution` for the cost and the profile

The generated Verilog, NIR and Uppaal text should not change, because co-simulation and golden runs check it.
Determinism should be one check in one place, because `SpikeTrace.Choices` is used by two exporters and the Uppaal refusal by a third rule.

Where: `SNP_Evolution/Export/`, `SNP_Evolution/Simulation/CompiledNetwork.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Simulation/SpikeTrace.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Simulation/PortRecorder.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Storage/PartLibraryFiles.cs`.

Done when:
- [ ] Every exporter implements `IExporter` and refuses with typed reasons
- [ ] `VerilogExporter.cs` is under 300 lines and no generator decides a delay kind or threshold itself
- [ ] Generated files byte-identical on the golden parts; co-simulation tests green; `dotnet test` green

Read first: RESEARCH.md "Hardware profile and exporters", "Proving contracts" (Model checking), README "Exporting to hardware"
